description: linear_recurrence mod.rs: original modular algorithm or independent oracle
state: Deterministic exact modular values; input slices immutable
cost: Initial-prefix queries take O(1) after length validation. Otherwise at most2*floor(log2(n))+1 polynomial combines, each O(k^2), plus O(k) final dot product; O(k^2 log(n+1)) word time and O(k) peak words. u128 remainder cost is hardware-dependent. k<=4096 is a policy cap, not a promise of fast maximum-order queries.
forward: For k seeds, a[t]=sum_{j=0}^{k-1}c[j]a[t-1-j] modulo nonzero m. Return a[n], using coefficients of x^n modulo x^k-sum c[j]x^(k-1-j) as weights on a[0..k]. Validation precedes the initial-prefix shortcut.

limitations: Finite correspondence only; allocation refusal not injected; no global semantic proof
